definition: A neural network trained to compress input data into a lower-dimensional representation and then reconstruct the original input from it.
details: Autoencoders are used for dimensionality reduction, denoising, and as building blocks for more advanced generative architectures like VAEs.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Autoencoder.
